description: Run strategy backtests on historical data, optimize parameters, identify new dataset opportunities, and keep Greg's trading edge validated and current.

workflows.name: run-backtest
workflows.description: Execute a backtest of a named strategy over a historical window
steps: Receive strategy spec: name, parameters, asset, timeframe, date range
Fetch historical OHLCV data from Hyper Liquid API for specified range
Execute backtest logic (apply entry/exit rules to historical data)
Calculate performance metrics: total return, Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, win rate, avg P&L
Summarize results: top 5 metrics + key strengths/weaknesses
Store results in memory tagged by strategy name + date
Optionally: trigger chart generation for equity curve
workflows.output: Backtest report with key metrics + equity curve data
workflows.blast_radius: Low — computation only, no live trades

workflows.name: optimize-strategy
workflows.description: Run parameter sweeps to find optimal settings for a strategy
steps: Receive strategy name + parameter ranges to sweep
Run backtest for each parameter combination (grid search or Bayesian)
Rank combinations by Sharpe ratio (or metric specified by Greg)
Check for overfitting: validate top configs on holdout period
Report: best params + performance + overfitting risk flag
workflows.output: Optimization report with top 3 configurations and overfitting assessment
workflows.approval_gate: None — autonomous analysis. Greg reviews and chooses.

workflows.name: scout-datasets
workflows.description: Overnight search for new data sources that could give trading edge
steps: Search for new publicly available datasets: on-chain data, social sentiment, options flow, etc.
Evaluate each source: data quality, update frequency, cost, API availability
Flag 1-3 promising new sources per week
Summarize in weekly dataset scouting report
workflows.output: Dataset scouting report (weekly) — included in morning brief if significant finds
workflows.approval_gate: None — research only. Greg decides whether to integrate.
